# Candidate Assessment

## Mandatory Requirements (10)

| # | Requirement | Evidence in résumé | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | Languages: Python | 1.0 |
| 2 | SQL | Languages: SQL | 1.0 |
| 3 | Linux administration | Platform: Linux administration | 1.0 |
| 4 | Git | Platform: Git | 1.0 |
| 5 | REST API design | Services: REST API design | 1.0 |
| 6 | Unit testing | Services: unit testing | 1.0 |
| 7 | CI pipelines | Services: CI pipelines | 1.0 |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | Has 4 of 5. **Helm missing.** | 0.8 |
| 9 | Kafka | Not shown | 0.0 |
| 10 | GraphQL | Not shown | 0.0 |

**Mandatory match: 7.8 / 10 = 78%**

## Combined Check

78% falls in the 78–84% band, so the combined figure is required.

**Nice to Have (5)**

| # | Requirement | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 11 | Grafana | 1.0 |
| 12 | Prometheus | 1.0 |
| 13 | Technical writing | 1.0 |
| 14 | Mentoring | 1.0 |
| 15 | Public speaking | 1.0 |

**Combined match: (7.8 + 5) / 15 = 12.8 / 15 ≈ 85.3%**

## Result

**Proceed.** The combined figure (85.3%) meets the 85% threshold.

## Caveats

- **The result depends on two boundaries.** The mandatory score sits exactly at 78%, and the combined score clears 85% by only 0.3 points. I read "between 78 and 84" as inclusive. If it is exclusive, 78% falls outside the band. The instructions don't say what happens outside the band, so the outcome would be undetermined.
- **Two mandatory gaps:** Kafka and GraphQL are absent, and Helm is missing within item 8. The candidate qualifies only because of strong nice-to-have coverage. These gaps would be worth checking in an interview.
